title: KubeSentinelDetectionRule
description: Schema definition for KubeSentinel Elasticsearch detection rules and threat hunting definitions.

name.description: Human-readable title of the detection rule.

description.description: Detailed explanation of what the detection rule identifies.

severity.description: Assigned severity level of the detection.

query.description: The exact query string to execute against Elasticsearch.

required_fields.description: List of Elasticsearch fields required by this rule.

technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ID (e.g. T1059.004).

technique_name.description: Official name of the MITRE ATT&CK technique.

mitre_attack.description: Optional conservative mappings to the MITRE ATT&CK framework. Omit this field when the telemetry does not support a specific technique.

hypothesis.description: Security hypothesis stating attacker motivation, tradecraft, and expected telemetry.

investigation_guide.description: Step-by-step triage guide for security analysts when this rule triggers.

false_positives.description: Known benign triggers, authorized activities, and tuning considerations.

limitations.description: Explicit discussion of detection blind spots, bypasses, or telemetry dependencies.
